'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Vince Hutchins DS Something Special Planned For Them (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vince Hutchins]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Something Special Planned For Them (V) (Dark)|Something Special Planned For Them (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
